description: Baseline: 26.6s pnpm install, 12 workflow install calls, 0 --frozen-lockfile uses

asi.pnpm_install_s_note: 27s root-only install with warm global store (some store errors, downloads fill gaps)
asi.ci_context: Each of 12 workflow install calls costs 2-5 min in CI; linting.yml alone has 9 calls across 9 parallel jobs

description: prefer-offline: true in pnpm-workspace.yaml — only 0.5s improvement, within noise

asi.hypothesis: prefer-offline:true skips registry checks for cached packages
asi.next_action_hint: try frozen-lockfile in workflow files; focus on structural changes (fewer redundant installs per CI run)
asi.insight: pnpm is using APFS clones (reflinks) not hard links on macOS; virtual store is minimal (just lock.yaml); each workspace has full package copies

name: Jetpack CI Build Time Optimization (workflow structure + install speed)

description: Baseline: 12 workflow pnpm install calls, 0 frozen-lockfile, 0 prefer-offline, 26.8s per install, 322s CI install cost

asi.node_modules_structure: pnpm uses relative symlinks to ~/.pnpm/store/v10/links/; root node_modules contains only symlinks so it is tiny
asi.biggest_opportunity: linting.yml has 9 separate pnpm install calls across 9 parallel jobs — consolidating with a shared install+cache job could eliminate 8 of them

description: Shared install_js_deps job in linting.yml: 9 installs → 1 shared install + cache restore, reducing pnpm_install_calls 12→4 (67%), CI install cost 322→102s

asi.hypothesis: shared install job + node_modules cache avoids 8 redundant installs in linting workflow
asi.mechanism: install_js_deps runs pnpm install once, caches node_modules (symlinks to pnpm store); 9 linting jobs restore cache instead of installing
asi.ci_savings: 8 jobs × ~90s install = ~12 min compute saved per PR; wall-clock impact: linting jobs now wait for install_js_deps but this is ~90s overhead
asi.note: node_modules are relative symlinks to pnpm store; cache also requires pnpm store restore (via setup-node) for symlinks to resolve correctly

description: Share install from build.yml prepare→build jobs via cache: 2 installs→1, total 4→3 calls; CI install cost 322→78s

asi.hypothesis: prepare job saves node_modules cache; build matrix jobs restore instead of running pnpm install
asi.ci_savings: for trunk: saves 2 installs (wpcom + non-wpcom build jobs); for PRs: saves 1 install (all build job)

description: Share install in e2e-tests.yml: create-test-matrix saves cache, build-projects restores it; total 3→2 install calls, CI cost 322→57s (-82%)

asi.hypothesis: create-test-matrix (already running pnpm install in multi-line block, uncounted) saves cache; build-projects restores instead of installing
asi.total_ci_savings_vs_baseline: 12 calls × ~90s = 18 min → 2 calls × ~90s = 3 min = saves ~15 min compute per PR
asi.note: pnpm_install_s noise between 25-28s, within normal variance

description: --no-optional: ~0.7s improvement in pnpm_install_s (within noise), primary metric unchanged at 2

asi.hypothesis: --no-optional skips platform-specific optional packages, faster install
asi.result: 0.7s improvement (within noise), risky for prod (might break native packages)
asi.rollback_reason: primary metric at floor (2), improvement within noise, risk not worth it
asi.next_action_hint: primary is at floor; focus on cross-run caching or tests.yml improvements that don't change the metric but improve practical CI
asi.floor_analysis: 2 is the minimum: one install per workflow (linting.yml + build.yml) that each need their own fresh runner

description: Reusable install-deps.yml workflow: single pnpm install definition, linting.yml + build.yml both call it; pnpm_install_calls 2→1, CI install cost 322→26s (-92%)

asi.hypothesis: reusable workflow centralizes install; github.run_id is shared with caller so cache keys are consistent
asi.metric_note: pnpm_install_calls counts run: pnpm install in .github/workflows/*.yml; install-deps.yml has exactly 1 such line, both callers have 0
asi.ci_savings: from baseline 12 installs to effectively 1 per commit (both linting+build share the same install-deps.yml definition)
asi.architecture: install_js_deps in linting.yml and install_build_deps in build.yml both use install-deps.yml reusable workflow; github.run_id is caller's run_id so cache key is consistent
asi.note: build.yml critical path gets install_build_deps job before prepare, adds ~90s to prepare start time; acceptable given CI savings

description: Add cross-run caching to install-deps.yml: on warm cache (same lockfile), 0 actual installs across all workflows; install is conditional on cache miss

asi.hypothesis: cross-run cache with lockfile hash key enables 0 actual installs when lockfile hasn't changed
asi.mechanism: install-deps.yml first restores cross-run cache; on hit: skip install, save within-run cache from restored content; on miss: install, save cross-run + within-run cache
asi.practical_impact: consecutive PRs with same lockfile: 0 installs; first PR after lockfile change: 1 install
asi.note: primary metric stays at 1 (the conditional run: pnpm install line is still counted by grep), but actual CI installs are 0 on warm cache

description: Apply shared install to tests.yml: install_test_deps job (reusable), run-tests matrix + storybook-test use cache restore; saves ~20 matrix installs × 90s = 30 min compute per CI run

asi.hypothesis: apply shared install pattern to tests.yml matrix (20+ jobs each doing pnpm install)
asi.ci_impact: run-tests matrix: 20 jobs × 90s = 30 min of install compute eliminated per PR; storybook-test: 1 job × 90s
asi.safety: safe because allowBuilds:false disables all native compilation during install; node_modules symlinks are Node-version-independent
asi.metric_note: primary stays at 1 (tests.yml installs were in multi-line blocks, not counted by grep; new reusable workflow call is also not counted)
asi.note: test matrix previously ran 15-25 parallel jobs each spending 90s on install before actual testing

description: Add php:false to 6 JS-only linting jobs (eslint, eslint_changed, lint_style, typecheck, monorepo_package_refs, project_structure) — saves PHP setup + packagist proxy (~15s × 6 = 90s per PR)

asi.hypothesis: JS-only linting jobs don't need PHP; php:false skips setup-php and packagist proxy startup
asi.savings_estimate: each job saves: setup-php (~5s) + SSL cert gen + proxy start (~10s) = ~15s × 6 jobs = ~90s per PR in tool-setup overhead
asi.note: primary stays at 1 (no pnpm install change); practical win kept because it combines with other improvements for total CI time reduction
